name: Sailani Tours N Travels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Sailani Tours N Travels Ltd is in the business of Travel and Travel-related services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
STNTL is engaged in the business of travel 
and tourism, and also holds a Forex Licence, 
foreign exchange and outgo, which largely 
happens on account of passengers.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.12 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.95% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 89.1 to 141 days.
